name: sagefin
description: Connects Claude to your SageFin household and teaches it to work on your books: categorize what is uncategorized, and suggest rules that keep it that way.

api_token.title: SageFin token
api_token.description: A token from SageFin: Settings → Integrations. Tick MCP, Transactions and Categories. Tick write access only if you want Claude to propose changes.
